gloss: to ring a bell; to click; to strike one as right

definitions.gloss: to click; to ring a bell; to strike one as right
definitions.explanation: Of an idea, name or thing: to be grasped or recognized in a flash, or to feel right at once. Very common in the negative ピンとこない, "it doesn't click, I can't really picture it". Also written ピンと{来|く}る.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧、ピンとこない。
examples.english: That name doesn't ring a bell.

examples.japanese: ⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ピンときた。
examples.english: As soon as I heard the explanation, it clicked.

examples.japanese: {何軒|なんけん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、ピンとくる⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{見|み}つからない→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: I've seen lots of apartments, but I just can't find one that feels right.

notes:
Built from the mimetic ⟦ピン→ピン：00344_pin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ (taut, with a sudden twang) and ⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧. The subject is the thing that clicks, not the person: ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ピンとこない, "the story doesn't click (for me)". Casual to neutral; in formal writing use ⟦{理解|りかい}できない→理解する：06059_rikaisuru⟧ or ⟦{実感|じっかん}→実感：04213_jikkan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧わかない.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ピンとこない: it doesn't click; I can't quite picture it
- ピンとくるもの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: something strikes a chord
- ⟦{一目|ひとめ}→一目：08728_hitome⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ピンときた: I knew at a glance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{思|おも}い{当|あ}たる→思い当たる：19251_omoiataru⟧: to come to mind, to have an idea (of a cause or person)
- ⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧: to understand — the plain, neutral word
